text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh. I've got me some special spice
today,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm feelin' a little better than
usual. What is
it people say again? I've
got a pop in my step
today?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's the one! I've got some pep in
my step!
choice_data_list_en: Meaning it has a unique twist?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If I lose again like last time, it'll give all
my fans
the blues.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll come out of this race the winner and
throw
everybody a big, happy party!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Anybody who gets in my way is goin'
down with a
bang! These legs of mine'll
blast them away!
